B168.title: The numbers under One portion show the whole recipe

opportunity.from: Seen while drawing B166, 23 November 2026, on Lazy Burek's page; Coach Milan 24 November 07:04: yes, its own ticket, we need to fix that.
opportunity.job: Read what one portion of my recipe holds.
opportunity.kind: Says something not true: the table under One portion shows the whole recipe.
opportunity.why_now: B166 made the table readable, so its numbers are now read.

B168.problem: On a recipe that makes 4 portions, the PD card says One portion, 549 kcal and 224 g. Its numbers say Total 897 g and 2,194 kcal, fat 135 g: the whole recipe. The Nutrition table below says 1 portion, 224 g. Two places on one page disagree about one portion.
B168.story: When I read a recipe's PD card and its numbers, I want them to say the same meal, so that I can trust what I plan and eat.
B168.now: The card says One portion, 549 kcal · 23.3 g protein · 224 g. Its numbers are handed the whole recipe: Total 897 g, 2,194 kcal. Cook it's − 4 portions + sits under the card and changes only the foods to cook.
B168.proposed: The top is the recipe as written and never moves: the PD card says The whole recipe · makes 4 servings, its rows 2,194 kcal, 897 g, 93 g, and its numbers Total 897 g and 2,194 kcal. One serving and 100 g stay in the Nutrition table, beside the whole recipe, fixed too. What changes with a choice is below the top, in How much (DT349). A serving is the recipe's equal share, the same for everyone; a portion is mine, calculated for a meal and my day (nutrition rule N17, Coach Milan 24 November 22:26).
B168.looked_at: The card at one portion (07:10): not chosen, 14:50: the header is the whole meal. − and + inside the card (07:55): not chosen, no more navigation in the card. The card following Cook it (08:05): not chosen; reading would change the batch. Numbers for above the card (14:00): not chosen, 14:49: the header is the meal; portioning goes somewhere else. Your portion on the recipe page (17:49 to 19:04): not in B168; a portion depends on the person, the meal and the day, so it comes when the reader picks a meal, DT351. The card following the count (25 November 07:54): not chosen, 07:58: the top is fixed, per full recipe as is. All 4 servings as the card's title (24 November): not chosen, it read like a selection next to Cook for.
B168.short: The PD card and its numbers are the whole recipe, as written, fixed; the recipe's count is servings; with DT349 in one release, 0.3.193

Nutrition rule N17 (docs/rules/nutrition.md): a serving is the recipe's equal share, a portion is mine. The recipe's unit portions, saved by the app, shows as serving and servings wherever a recipe's count shows: the recipe page, a read recipe's card, the delete question (recipe.unit.portions, recipe.portion, recipe.portions, recipe.wholeByWeight). DT349.title: The recipe page in two zones: the recipe as written on top, How much below (servings, or my portions for a meal), Foods as one block

opportunity.from: Coach Milan 24 November 2026, 07:42, looking at the board B168; 13:44 to 14:50, brainstorm on the header and the portions. 25 November 07:54 to 08:02, looking at the board on his phone: the card and Cook for are not in sync; the structure of the page.
opportunity.job: Read a recipe as it is written, then see how much of it is mine or how much I make, in one place.
opportunity.kind: Did not find it or did not understand it: the recipe's PD card looks different from the Plate's; Cook it looks like a button and sits by the numbers, which it does not change.
opportunity.why_now: B168 makes the card count a chosen number of portions, so the card and the cooking need their own places.

DT349.problem: The recipe page's PD card has its own layout: one small line for kcal, protein and grams, its numbers inside the card. On the Plate the same card has rows and opens its numbers under it. Cook it, under the card, looks like a call to action and says 1 portions. Drawn on 24 November, the card said All 4 servings while Cook for below could say 1 or 10: two counts on one page, not in sync. And Cook for 4 sounds like four people, who do not eat the same amount.
DT349.story: When I open a recipe, I want to read it as it is written, and below that choose how I see it, as its servings or as my own meal, so that the amount, its numbers and the foods always say the same thing.
DT349.now: Recipe page: title, a No photo yet card with two buttons, the PD card (own layout: one small line, numbers inside), a Cook it card with − 4 portions + that looks like a button and says 1 portions, Foods, Nutrition, Steps with Start cooking.
DT349.proposed: 1. The top is the recipe as written, fixed: title, photo, the PD card for the whole recipe, and further down the Nutrition table (25 November 07:58). 2. No photo yet: a placeholder picture of a meal in the photo's place, with No photo yet, Let Chef Mealan draw one and Add my photo on it. 3. The PD card is the Plate's card, one component (PdCard); the numbers open under the card. 4. How much, one block under the top, with two controls (08:02). See it as: Just looking, or one of my meals today (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack). The count under it: in Just looking it counts the recipe's servings, chips 1 to 5, the recipe's number as written, the plan's number, Other with − and + for an exact number; seen as a meal it counts my portions for that meal, 1 to 5 and Other. One line gives the numbers for the choice: 2 servings: 1,097 kcal · 449 g · 47 g protein · PD 4.3, or Your dinner portion: 300 g · 733 kcal · 31 g protein · PD 4.3, and how many of my portions the whole recipe is. 5. Foods is one block, only the list, named for the choice (Foods for 2 servings, Foods for 1 dinner portion). The Cook it card goes; the words Cook for go. 6. My portion is calculated from that meal's size today (what is left of my day, shared over the meals to come; nutrition rules N11 and N17) and capped at the whole recipe. The PD never changes. Nothing about the author's goal is shown. 7. docs/rules/design.md D8: every PD card is PdCard and opens its numbers under it; design-rules.cjs checks it. DT351 is merged into this ticket.
DT349.looked_at: Only − and +: not chosen; three taps from 4 to 1, every time. Only chips: not chosen, 17:38: an exact number is needed too (Other). The portions to cook above the PD card (14:00): not chosen, the header is the meal. The portions at Start cooking: not chosen, far from the foods they change. Each person's own portion (a father, a mother, a kid of 10, a kid of 3): later, its own ticket, DT350 (17:38). A food's PD card (FoodCard): not in DT349, unless Coach Milan says. Cook for as the label (24 November): not chosen, 25 November 08:01: it hides whose amounts these are; Servings and Portions say it. One selection that also moves the PD card (07:54): not chosen, the top is fixed. The meal choice as a later ticket (DT351): merged here, 08:02.
DT349.short: The recipe page in two zones: the recipe as written on top (PdCard, D8, a placeholder photo), How much below (See it as; servings or my portions), Foods as one block; DT351 merged in; with B168, 0.3.193
